messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hi! I want to buy your iPhone listed on OLX. I'm out of country but my agent will pick it up.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sure, payment method? Cash on pickup preferred.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: I'll pay online through OLX wallet protection. Just buy a 4,000 PKR Google Play card and share the code as your identity verification.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: That sounds odd, why would identity need a Play card?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: It unlocks your seller wallet, standard process now. Do it fast, another buyer is also interested.
